feeds.title: Broadway Musical Blog
feeds.description: Dishing out musical theatre news and gossip from the Great White Way. The companion site to The Broadway Musical Home is a directory of Broadway musicals with the story, songs, merchandise, video clips, lyrics, tickets, rights & awards for almost 200 shows.

feeds.title: The Theatre Times
feeds.description: The Theatre Times is the largest global theatre portal and publishes news stories on daily basis from a variety of sources. Our goal is to create a transnational discursive space that would bring together theatre-makers and theatre lovers, facilitating global collaborative models, and generating opportunities for interaction and creative development amongst a wide network of international theatre-makers and theatergoers.

feeds.title: CAROLE DI TOSTI » NYC Theater Reviews
feeds.description: Read the theatre reviews of New York City teathres. Carole Di Tosti, Ph.D. is a journalist, writer, blogger, poet, novelist, and researcher. Carole Di Tosti administrates and edits three blogs. Her writing centers on eclectic topics and advocacy issues. You will find her advocacy writings published at The Fat and the Skinny.

feeds.title: Theatre of the Oppressed NYC
feeds.description: Theatre of the Oppressed NYC partners with community members at local organizations to form theatre troupes. These troupes devise and perform plays based on their challenges confronting economic inequality, racism, and other social, health, and human rights injustices. After each performance, actors and audiences engage in theatrical brainstorming - called Forum Theatre - with the aim of catalyzing creative change on the individual, community, and political levels.

feeds.title: American Theatre
feeds.description: American Theatre magazine is the nation's only general-circulation magazine devoted to theatre. American Theatre provides theatre news, features, artist interviews, and editorials about theatre in the US and abroad.

feeds.title: New York Stage Review
feeds.description: New York Stage Review publishes up-to-date reviews of Broadway and off-Broadway plays and musicals from veteran theater critics. It is our experience that informed dramatic criticism plays an important part in guiding readers to productions that they might not otherwise attend; not merely heralding the latest blockbusters, but offering readers a sense of whether they might find a specific production rewarding. With that goal in view, we have banded together to form New York Stage Review.

feeds.title: Broadway News
feeds.description: Get the latest and trendy broadway breaking news, headlines and reviews from your one and only accurate news source, Broadway News.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Theatre
feeds.description: Read the latest news about Broadway, Off-Broadway, London, and West End performances, casts, audio plays, streaming performances, and more. Theater reviews by chief critic Jesse K. Green. We value thoughtful comments representing a range of views that make their point politely.

feeds.title: NYCPlaywrights
feeds.description: NYCPlaywrights provides playwright submission opportunities; discounts; free shows and other theatre items for New York City and the world.

feeds.title: Ken Davenport Blog
feeds.description: Ken Davenport is a Tony Award-winning Broadway producer. His productions have been produced internationally in over 25 countries around the world. He is the founder of TheaterMakers Studio, a one-of-a-kind 'masterclass' community that provides training and inspiration from Broadway's best to writers, directors, producers, and more.

feeds.title: amNewYork » Theatre
feeds.description: Get the latest local stories, photos, and videos on theatres. amNewYork is a digital magazine that gives you all the information you need about a theatre. They also cover news, sports, jobs, finance, and more.

feeds.title: New York Theater
feeds.description: This is Jonathan Mandell's New York Theater blog, where you will read reviews and news about Broadway, Off-Broadway and independent theater, and occasionally some off-topic commentary. New York Theater offers weekly summaries of theater news, a monthly calendar of theater openings, monthly theater quizzes, and occasional ticket giveaways. In this publication, I discuss issues in the arts, and books, and theater etiquette, and I crack jokes. But mostly, I write theater reviews.

feeds.title: Broadway World
feeds.description: Your guide to all things theatre on Broadway and around the world including shows, news, reviews, broadway tickets, regional theatre, and more.

feeds.title: New York Theatre Workshop Blog
feeds.description: We are a community of artists and audience members who believe in the transformative power of theatre. For 40 years, New York Theatre Workshop has cultivated a space where our common humanity is affirmed-where audiences are both challenged and delighted by the daring vision of our artists. We believe theatre can deepen empathy and spark wonder.

feeds.title: Theater Pizzazz » Theatre
feeds.description: Read the blog for articles the explain the inside life of a theatre. Sandi Durell is the Publisher/Editor of TheaterPizzazz.com an entertainment website featuring a variety of writer voices. Sandi has been writing, reviewing, producing, and having a voice in theater, cabaret, and the entertainment community for over 30+ years. She is a Voting Member of the Drama Desk and Outer Critics Circle Awards and a member of the American Theatre Critics Association.

feeds.title: TandBOnTheAisle Blog
feeds.description: TandBOnTheAisle Blog is the commentary & previews of what's happening on NYC stages © 2011 Tamara Beck.

feeds.title: New York Post » Theatre
feeds.description: Get the latest theater news, reviews, and ticket information about Broadway and Off-Broadway shows on the New York Post. Founded in 1801 by Alexander Hamilton, the New York Post has been telling stories for over 200 years. Stories that shape your world. That makes you smile. That causes you to share. We shine a bright light on the people and institutions that shape our readers' lives; we break big stories and set the news agenda; and we offer engaging, fun, and addictive content to the country and the world.

feeds.title: StageLight Magazine
feeds.description: StageLight Magazine brings you the best of Broadway, Off-Broadway and day to day of the NYC theatre world. StageLight Magazine is used as the program for several off-Broadway shows and also run StageLight Black and StageLight Paper.

feeds.title: Broadway Black
feeds.description: Broadway Black is an organization that fosters and inspires artistic diversity and excellence in theatre. Dedicated to highlighting the achievements and successes of Black theatre artists on and off the Broadway stage. It's the place for Black people to see themselves center stage.

feeds.title: La MaMa Blogs
feeds.description: La MaMa Experimental Theatre Club is dedicated to the artist and all aspects of the theatre. Founded in 1961 by Ellen Stewart, La MaMa is recognized as the seedbed of new work by artists of all nations and cultures. La MaMa is the place where emerging artists learn from established artists and where artists from around the globe share work and ideas.

feeds.title: The Theatre Podcast Blog
feeds.description: Alan is a North Carolina native with over 20 years of direct, hands-on experience in tv, film, and theatre. He has been an actor, singer, dancer, producer, director of photography, audio engineer, and editor, in addition to utilizing his computer science degree to work for several of the top tech companies in existence. His unique approach to hosting creates direct, real, human conversations that elevate The Theatre Podcast conversations to an intimate level of heightened curiosity.

feeds.title: Bluebird Theatre Company Blog
feeds.description: Bluebird Theatre Company brings you the latest news and trends pertaining to their sphere, as an International NYC-based theatre group. Connect with New York's theatre culture and other interesting ramblings in our blog. Bluebird is an International 501(c)(3) LLC non-profit theatre company committed to portraying inspiring, stories that spark curiosity.

feeds.title: SITI Company Blog
feeds.description: SITI Company is an ensemble-based theater company whose three ongoing components are the creation of new work, the training of theater artists, and a commitment to crossing boundaries. SITI Company was founded in 1992 by Tadashi Suzuki, Anne Bogart, and a group of like-minded artists interested in revitalizing and redefining contemporary theater in the United States through international cultural exchange, the creation of new work, and the training of theater artists. Originally envisioned as the Saratoga International Theater Institute (SITI) in Saratoga Springs, NY,

feeds.title: Lincoln Center Theater Blog
feeds.description: Explore behind-the-scenes essays, photos, videos, and podcasts from Lincoln Center Theater.

feeds.title: The Broadway Blog
feeds.description: The Broadway Blog is an insider's guide to theatre and live performance in New York City Broadway, Off-Broadway, and beyond. Get a personal spin on theatre news, the latest reviews, backstage gossip and exclusive interviews with the stars and creators of your favorite plays and musicals.

feeds.title: Broadway Direct
feeds.description: The Nederlander Organization established Broadway Direct in 2011 to help its patrons around the country stay connected to every show on Broadway. With this insider access, we're able to bring you the latest Broadway news, behind-the-scenes stories, backstage videos, and expert tips to help you find your next show.
